in_marathi.name: Kashyapraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kashyapraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Kashyapraj is derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'God's creator'. It is a significant name in Hindu mythology, where Kashyap is considered the creator of human beings and the sages. In Hindu tradition, Kashyapraj is believed to symbolize wisdom, knowledge, and creation.

vedic_reference.note: Kashyapa is a sage and progenitor in Hindu mythology. He is the father of many demigods including the Ashwini Kumaras and Dhananjaya, as well as the great sage Vedavyasa, the compiler of the Vedas and Mahabharata.
